IdentityMaster of the fundamentals: any weapon, any armour, and combat manoeuvres no one else can match. Where other classes lean on tricks, the Fighter wins by doing the basics better than anyone.

Level by Level at a Glance

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Weapon Specialisation: Choose one weapon — you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and gain +1 damage with it.
  • Improves to +2 damage at 7th level
  • Improves to +3 damage at 19th level
  • At 13th level, choose a second weapon to specialise in, or add a further +1 damage to your first

1st Level — Combat Manoeuvres

  • Combat Manoeuvres: Every character can use every manoeuvre; the Fighter's edge is Manoeuvre Mastery. See the Combat Manoeuvres section for details.
  • Combat Reflexes: You have the Combat Reflexes feat for free (see The Feats of Arneyan in Character Creation). It doesn't use a feat slot.

2nd Level — Manoeuvre Mastery

  • Manoeuvre Mastery: Manoeuvres that impose disadvantage on your own attack roll (Shield Blow) are now rolled normally, with no disadvantage.
  • 9th level: Contest-based manoeuvres (Trip, Disarm, Dirty Trick) are now rolled with advantage.
  • 19th level: Manoeuvres that previously imposed disadvantage on your attack roll are now rolled with advantage instead.

3rd Level — Battle Space

  • Battle Space: You control the space around you in ways most fighters never learn.
  • You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only when directly opposite
  • 13th level: +1 AC unless wielding a two-handed weapon, and you reroll 1s on Flank Attack damage
  • 17th level: a Flank Attack also deals +1 damage die

4th Level — Combat Dominance

  • Combat Dominance: When every creature you attack this round is of Level up to half your character Level, you can make extra attacks (your Fighter level sets how many, below), split among them as you like.
  • 4th level: 2 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your character Level
  • 8th level: 3 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your character Level
  • 12th level: 4 attacks per round against creatures of Level up to half your character Level
  • All but the first attack are rolled with Disadvantage. Combat Dominance replaces the Extra Attack and the off-hand attack; Flowing Strikes can still add one.

5th Level — Unbroken

  • Unbroken: Once per day, when reduced to 0 HP or below, immediately stand at 1 HP.
  • No save, no check — pure will
  • 24th level: once per encounter instead; for the next round you are immune to all damage and your attacks deal +2 damage dice, then normal rules resume

6th Level — Legend of Battle

  • Legend of Battle: Once per day, for 1 round you become a force of war that lesser fighters can only dream of.
  • All attack rolls are made with advantage
  • Every hit deals maximum damage — no rolling
  • 20th level: lasts 1 minute, and enemies that can see you must make a Will save (Class Save DC) at the start of each of their turns or be frightened for 1 round

7th Level — Extra Attack

  • Extra Attack: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Does not stack with Combat Dominance — choose one or the other each round

8th Level — Shield Mastery

  • Shield Mastery: Use a shield as a second weapon without the normal two-weapon attack penalty. It is a Light weapon dealing 1d4 (1d6 for a Tower Shield), and it keeps its AC bonus.

15th Level — Strength Bonus

  • Strength Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to Strength.

19th Level — Attribute Bonus

  • Attribute Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to either Strength or Dexterity.

22nd Level — Battle Space (Master)

  • Battle Space (Master): You move through combat like water — nothing holds you and nothing catches you.
  • When you attack, you may also Disengage from any number of enemies as part of the same action
  • You have Advantage on Reflex saves
  • A Flank Attack deals +2 damage dice instead, and the target cannot make Attacks of Opportunity against you until the start of your next turn

Combat Manoeuvres

Every manoeuvre in the Combat Manoeuvres section is available to the Fighter from 1st level, and Mastery tiers unlock at 2nd, 9th and 19th level (see Class Abilities). The Fighter also has one manoeuvre of their own:

ManoeuvreEffect
Intimidating StrikeOn a hit, target makes Will save or is frightened until end of its next turn

Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Fighter folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Kits represent your fighting tradition, background, and the culture that forged you.
